source.attribution: Place codes: Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU), Place Codes Release 9.7 (Jan 2026).
source.checked_against: First matched on Release 9.5 (Feb 2024), then re-run on 9.7. For Maungdaw, Buthidaung, Rathedaung and Sittwe the two releases are identical in every field: same 4 townships, 291 village tracts and 1,085 villages, same codes, names, statuses and coordinates. The 9.6-to-9.7 change history lists no change in these townships.

cross_check.dataset: Myanmar - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), source MIMU, hosted on HDX
cross_check.used_for: Confirming township and village-tract codes still exist in the HDX boundary set, and tract centroids. HDX writes district codes as MMR012001/MMR012002 where MIMU writes MMR012D001/MMR012D002.

meta.code_format: Township, village-tract codes are MMR-prefixed (e.g. MMR012009, MMR012009034). MIMU village P-codes are 6-digit numbers (e.g. 197894) exactly as published.

tiers.exact: Coordinates identical to the MIMU village point, name identical, same village tract.
tiers.strong: Coordinates identical (or within 250 m) and name differs only in spelling, or name identical but tract label differs (flagged).
tiers.probable: Name and tract match a single MIMU village but coordinates disagree (or cannot be compared). Needs a person to confirm.
tiers.shared: More than one FARA record maps to the same MIMU village code.
tiers.ambiguous: Two or more MIMU villages are plausible; left unresolved with candidates listed.
tiers.none: No MIMU village found. Recorded as having no official code.

method_notes: FARA rohingya_name was not used for matching. MIMU "commonly used local name" is carried in mimu_local_name for information only.
FARA id 338 was excluded from all coordinate comparisons.
Distance is great-circle metres between the FARA point and the MIMU village point.
